description: This source file defines the CachedCatalogViewModelService class, which implements the ICatalogViewModelService interface. It provides cached versions of catalog data retrieval methods such as GetBrands, GetTypes, and GetCatalogItems, leveraging IMemoryCache for in-memory caching to improve performance.

classes.name: CachedCatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class that provides cached access to catalog data, implementing ICatalogViewModelService and utilizing in-memory caching for performance optimization.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of brand selection items, cached to optimize repeated access.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves catalog items with pagination and optional filtering, with caching based on parameters.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of catalog types, cached for performance.
